summary: Contrasts includes with imports: a condition on include_* applies only to the include task itself, so both set_fact and debug in the included file run.
questions: What's the difference between include and import when using when?
Does the when on include_tasks propagate to the included tasks?

answer_card.title: Conditionals on includes
answer_card.answer_md: On `include_*`, the condition applies **only to the include task itself**, not to the tasks inside. With `include_tasks: other_tasks.yml` + `when: x is not defined`, if `x` is undefined the file is included and both `set_fact` and `debug` run unconditionally.
